summary: Innovation Beverage Group Ltd, an Australian foreign private issuer listed in the US, furnished a Form 6-K reporting results of an Extraordinary General Meeting held October 9, 2026. Shareholders approved a resolution authorizing a reverse stock split under Australian law; results are in Exhibit 99.1. No price, share consolidation ratio, record date, or implementation timetable is disclosed in the excerpt, and no advisor or board recommendation beyond the EGM approval is named. This is an ordinary meeting-result notice, not a special situation; watch for a subsequent filing specifying the split ratio and effective date.
